build.system: Linux container, memory limit 6 GiB, no GPU devices or model assets; source and pinned llama.cpp mounted read-only; apt package install used Ubuntu snapshot index before compilation

options.initial_artifact_lookup_note: The chained wrapper checked /build/bin/strata, which was not this target's output path. A separate no-network check located /build/strata, verified its SHA-256, resolved dynamic dependencies, and passed --help.

build.command: apt-get update; DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends cmake ninja-build; cmake -S /src/strata -B /build -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DSTRATA_ENABLE_CUDA=ON -DSTRATA_HIP_GFX906=ON -DCMAKE_HIP_ARCHITECTURES=gfx906 -DSTRATA_GGML_DIR=/src/llama.cpp -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=/opt/rocm/llvm/bin/clang -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=/opt/rocm/llvm/bin/clang++; ninja -C /build -j2 strata
build.log_ref: Local-only build log retained outside the repository; the Ninja build completed 147/147 steps. The first wrapper returned 1 only on its post-build path probe; a separate no-network check verified the actual /build/strata artifact.

artifact.name: compile-only gfx906 Strata binary; not a release artifact or the archived benchmark binary
